notes.title: Zurarararush!!! Demo Update
notes.notes:
Notice
Due to major changes and adjustments, the online ranking has been reset.

System Updates
Upgraded to Unity 6

Added outlines to enemy characters and their projectiles for better visibility

Slow-motion effect is now triggered when the player uses a bomb

Items now follow the player when the player is in their path, making them easier to pick up

The Invincibility & Speed-Up item has been replaced with an Invincibility item; its visual effect has also been updated

Adjusted the Boomerang Zura to now fire in 3-way shots

In multiplayer mode, each player now has a separate Zura UI display


Adjustments
In Score Attack mode, only easier-to-use Zura types will appear in the early stages

The first stage background in Score Attack mode has been updated to better fit the game’s setting

Reduced enemy HP to ease overall difficulty


Known Issues
If a bomb is used during the effect duration of the Invincibility item, the invincibility duration may end prematurely



We are actively working on fixing any bugs that arise during gameplay.
Due to prioritization of development tasks, some aspects of the user experience (UX) may still feel rough or incomplete.
We appreciate your understanding and patience.

notes.title: [ver0.1]Zurarararush!!! Demo Update
notes.notes:
High Score Submission

 You can now choose in the options whether to automatically submit your high scores when achieved.
 Enabled manual high score submission from the Ranking Menu.

Other Updates

 Adjusted enemy spawn locations in certain areas.
 In multiplayer mode, the game will no longer start unless two controllers are connected.
